decision_states.ELIGIBLE_FOR_REVIEW: all preregistered gates passed; not auto-promoted
decision_states.REJECTED_PROSPECTIVE: worse on both primary metrics after minimum sample with uncertainty supporting harm
decision_states.INCONCLUSIVE_CONTINUE: minimum sample reached but strict promotion/rejection criteria not met

anti_retuning: No candidate model, feature list, coefficient, imputer, scaler, C or gate threshold may change before the prospective review. A new specification requires a new experiment ID and new future epoch.
